messages:
Sam (AE): Starting a thread for GoodCorp POC questions. They want: 1) sustained 300 tpm during 9-5 local, 2) p99 < 200ms for short chat, 3) no external egress (air-gapped-ish). Can we support with Reserved GPUs + autoscale?

Priya (Sales Eng): TL;DR: yes. Rough sizing depends on avg tokens/session and concurrency. If avg request = 40 tokens and avg response = 60 tokens, token rate ~ 40k tokens/hour for 300 tpm. Preliminary: 1xL4x2-equivalent handles ~3k tokens/sec for short context; but network/KV cache affects p99.

Liam (SRE): Practical plan: Dedicated cluster in customer VPC (VPC peering) -> required for no-egress. Provision time ~10-14 business days. For target p99=200ms we should reserve 2 GPUs (min=2) and allow autoscale max=4 with burst credits. min=1 not allowed for Dedicated in their setup? we need to confirm.

Hook (Security): GoodCorp will need SOC2 report, KMS integration, and egress controls. Also they asked for host-level patch schedule. We can provide SOC2 + KMS via customer-managed keys, but host patches are monthly; flag that in SOW.

Priya (Sales Eng): Autoscale suggestion config snippet:
```
autoscale:
  tier: dedicated
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 4
  cooldown: 60s
  scale_by: token_rate
  burst_window: 1h
```
Note: set concurrency_limit=10 to keep per-GPU latency stable.

Omar (Finance): Pricing ballpark (list): Dedicated L4x2-equivalent ~$10k/mo per GPU; on-demand ~ $14k/mo. We can do a 12mo commit at 25% off list if they commit to reserved capacity. Will follow up with tiered discounts and seat pricing.

Sam (AE): They asked if we can do a mixed approach: Hosted POC to move fast then flip to Dedicated if they sign. Legal insists no egress during POC though. Any workaround?

Liam (SRE): Hosted cannot guarantee no internet egress in their strict sense. We could set up Hosted in a private subnet with strict egress rules for a short POC, but it's not the same as hosting inside customer's VPC. Risk: compliance team may push back. Recommend presenting timeline tradeoffs.

Karen (Prod): Operational notes: KV cache warmup matters. If POC traffic is bursty, recommend pre-warming with a replay script to prime caches so p99 numbers meet target. Also add a canary rollout to avoid noisy neighbor regressions.

Priya (Sales Eng): Example pre-warm command (short):
```
ab -n 1000 -c 20 -T application/json -p payload.json https://poc.goodcorp.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Will include a runbook with expected token distributions.

Omar (Finance): Action for quote: list two options in the proposal: A) 2x reserved GPUs (12mo) + autoscale to 4 for bursts, B) 1x reserved + hosted fallback (if they allow limited egress). Show monthly TCO and per-token estimates.

Sam (AE): Action items: Priya -> perf runbook + prewarm steps by Tue. Liam -> provisioning ETA for Dedicated VPC by EOW. Omar -> draft two pricing options. Hook -> security checklist + KMS integration notes. I will present to GoodCorp on Wed.

ops-bot: Dedicated cluster request submitted (req-9921). Estimated provisioning start: 2026-04-02.

Priya (Sales Eng): I'll also include recommended autoscale policy for cost control: aggressive cooldown + short burst window so we don't stay at max long.

Hook (Security): I'll attach SOC2 pointer doc and KMS guidelines to the thread shortly.

Sam (AE): Nice, thanks team. Will update after Wed call.
